verdict.rationale: Edge0 has a CLI that loads and serves models (`edge0 serve edge0-35b`, `--no-prerouter`/`--no-lora`), so this axis applies to it. However, nothing in the evidence documents a user-settable GPU offload or context-length flag. SSD expert offload is automatic rather than a configurable GPU offload setting, and `--max-new` caps generated tokens, not context length; both are adjacent controls that earn no credit.
